name: Manufacturing & Quality Control Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Manufacturing Operations and Quality Control, covering Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Master Production Scheduling (MPS), work order execution, shop-floor tracking, quality inspections, non-conformance CAPA, scrap management, and preventive maintenance.

checklists.name: Manufacturing & Quality Control Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for MRP BOM explosion, work order tracking, quality inspection, non-conformance, and CAPA.

items.statement: Bill of Materials (BOM) revisions are controlled and material availability verified prior to work order release.
Shop-floor execution logs machine runtime, operator ID, produced quantity, and scrapped material.
Quality inspection plans execute at defined control points (incoming, in-process, final release).
Defective components trigger Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) and material quarantine.
Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPA) plans perform 5-Why / 8D root-cause analysis with verification of effectiveness.

reviewGates.name: Quality Assurance Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Quality Assurance Director confirms that manufacturing inspections, NCR quarantines, and CAPA resolutions meet ISO 9001 standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the manufacturing quality documentation confirm product compliance and CAPA effectiveness?

obligationDefinitions.title: A quality non-conformance must be tracked to CAPA closure
obligationDefinitions.description: A Non-Conformance Report raised during manufacturing quality control must produce a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) tracked to closure, not merely a rework of the single affected unit.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Non-Conformance Report has a linked CAPA that reaches a recorded closed state.

requiredEvidence.title: CAPA closure record
requiredEvidence.description: CAPA record showing closure against the originating Non-Conformance Report.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Does every Non-Conformance Report have a CAPA that reached closure?
